artifacts.summary: Preliminary findings document outlining potential compliance issues

items.text:
## Summary

Initial inventory review reveals three non‑compliant storage locations and their remediation deadlines; the scope is ready for lock‑in pending final sign‑off.

## Overview

Irene Cruz and Zane Smith have compiled the latest inventory of on‑prem PostgreSQL clusters and flagged S3 buckets in the restricted folder **/shared/security/audit/inventory_draft**. This draft will remain in that restricted folder until the formal scope sign‑off is obtained.

## Identified Non‑Compliant Data Stores

- **/srv/db/legacy_pg** – on‑prem PostgreSQL instance.
- **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025** (keep within the team) – archived S3 bucket.
- **//fileserver/finance/backups** (restricted folder) – finance backups file share.

These three paths were cross‑referenced against the compliance matrix and flagged as out of compliance.

## Remediation Schedule

- **/srv/db/legacy_pg** – remediation target **2026‑02‑12**.
- **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025** – remediation target **2026‑02‑20** (keep within the team).
- **//fileserver/finance/backups** – remediation target **2026‑02‑15** (restricted folder).

All dates are aligned with the compliance matrix and have been recorded in the inventory draft.

## Next Steps & Review

Irene Cruz will continue to monitor the inventory draft and verify that no additional stores appear before the scope is locked. Zane Smith will stand by to address any variance reports. Leon Marchetti will perform a technical review of this brief before it is circulated to the broader audit team.

form.title: Preliminary Findings – Security Audit of Existing Data Stores

artifacts.summary: Review meeting presenting audit results to stakeholders

items.text:
## Agenda

- Present audit findings for the three non‑compliant data stores
- Validate remediation deadlines (2026‑02‑12, 2026‑02‑15, 2026‑02‑20)
- Discuss scope‑lock process and required sign‑off
- Define next steps and assign owners

## Discussion

### Attendees
- **Irene Cruz** (Senior Platform Engineer)
- **Leon Marchetti** (ML Engineer)
- **Zane Smith** (Security Engineer)

### Review of Findings
Irene opened the session by displaying the preliminary findings document stored in the restricted folder **/shared/security/audit/inventory_draft**. She confirmed the three flagged locations:
- **/srv/db/legacy_pg** – on‑prem PostgreSQL instance, remediation target **2026‑02‑12**.
- **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025** (keep within the team) – archived S3 bucket, remediation target **2026‑02‑20** (keep within the team).
- **//fileserver/finance/backups** (restricted folder) – finance backups file share, remediation target **2026‑02‑15** (restricted folder).

Leon walked through the compliance matrix cross‑check and affirmed that each path still appears in the inventory draft and that no additional stores were discovered in the latest diff.

Zane highlighted the operational impact of the remediation windows, noting that the February dates fall within the upcoming sprint and that the required configuration changes have already been scoped.

### Scope‑Lock Discussion
The group agreed that the audit scope is ready to be locked, but a formal sign‑off from Legal is required before remediation work can commence. Irene will prepare a legal‑review packet and circulate it to **a General Counsel** (General Counsel) after the meeting.

### Open Questions
- Whether any downstream data pipelines need to be paused for the **/srv/db/legacy_pg** migration.
- Confirmation from the finance team that the backup share can be taken offline on **2026‑02‑15**.

These items will be addressed in follow‑up tickets.

### Summary
No final remediation approval was granted; the team will defer the scope lock until legal sign‑off is received and the open questions are resolved.

## Decisions

- Scope lock‑in deferred pending legal sign‑off and resolution of open questions on data pipelines and finance backup availability

## Action items

- Prepare legal‑review packet with remediation schedule — owner: Irene Cruz; due: 2026-02-07
- Schedule a sign‑off meeting with Legal and Finance stakeholders — owner: Zane Smith; due: 2026-02-10
- Perform technical validation of pipeline impact for /srv/db/legacy_pg — owner: Leon Marchetti; due: 2026-02-12

## Summary

The audit confirms three non‑compliant data stores and records the final decision to approve the findings and remediation plan.

## Scope and Inventory

Irene Cruz compiled the latest inventory of on‑prem PostgreSQL clusters and flagged S3 buckets in the restricted folder **/shared/security/audit/inventory_draft** (restricted folder). The inventory was cross‑checked against the compliance matrix and verified by Leon Marchetti, confirming no additional stores beyond the three listed.

## Compliance Gaps and Remediation Schedule

The audit identified the following non‑compliant storage locations:

- **/srv/db/legacy_pg** – on‑prem PostgreSQL instance; remediation target **2026‑02‑12**.
- **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025** (keep within the team) – archived S3 bucket; remediation target **2026‑02‑20** (keep within the team).
- **//fileserver/finance/backups** (restricted folder) – finance backups file share; remediation target **2026‑02‑15** (restricted folder).

All three paths remain listed in **/shared/security/audit/inventory_draft** (restricted folder) and are documented in the legal‑review packet located at **/shared/security/audit/legal_review** (restricted folder). Leon Marchetti will continue the technical validation of pipeline impact for **/srv/db/legacy_pg** and store results under **/shared/security/audit/validation_results** (restricted folder).

Zane Smith (Security Engineer) reviewed the findings and formally issued the decision: **Approve audit findings and remediation plan**. This decision authorizes the remediation schedule outlined above and permits the scope‑lock to proceed pending legal sign‑off. The decision and supporting documentation are to remain within the restricted folders until the formal sign‑off is obtained.

form.title: Final Security Audit Report – Data Store Compliance Gaps

artifacts.summary: Remediation ticket logging required fixes for each non‑compliant store

items.text:
## Description

Following the **Approve audit findings and remediation plan** decision (2026‑02‑03), the three data stores flagged as non‑compliant must be brought into compliance before the next sprint ends.

- **/srv/db/legacy_pg** – on‑prem PostgreSQL instance. Remediation target **2026‑02‑12**.
- **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025** (keep within the team) – archived S3 bucket. Remediation target **2026‑02‑20** (keep within the team).
- **//fileserver/finance/backups** (restricted folder) – finance backups file share. Remediation target **2026‑02‑15** (restricted folder).

All paths are listed in the inventory draft at **/shared/security/audit/inventory_draft** (restricted folder) and referenced in the legal‑review packet located at **/shared/security/audit/legal_review** (restricted folder). Leon Marchetti will continue technical validation of pipeline impact for the PostgreSQL instance and store results under **/shared/security/audit/validation_results** (restricted folder).

**Owner responsibilities**
- **Irene Cruz** – coordinate the removal of legacy data from the PostgreSQL instance, update configuration, and verify post‑remediation backups.
- **Leon Marchetti** – complete pipeline‑impact validation for **/srv/db/legacy_pg** and document any required changes in the validation folder.
- **Zane Smith** – ensure the S3 bucket lifecycle policy is updated to meet compliance, and confirm the finance backup share access controls are tightened.

All work must remain within the restricted folders until the formal legal sign‑off is received.

## Remediation Steps

- **Step 1 – PostgreSQL cleanup** (owner: Irene Cruz)
 1. Export current data from **/srv/db/legacy_pg** to a secure staging area.
 2. Apply required encryption settings and remove deprecated tables.
 3. Run the validation script produced by Leon Marchetti (stored in **/shared/security/audit/validation_results**) and confirm no pipeline breakage.
 4. Update the inventory draft to mark the store as compliant and record completion date.

- **Step 2 – S3 bucket policy update** (owner: Zane Smith)
 1. Review the current bucket ACLs for **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025**.
 2. Apply encryption‑at‑rest and enforce MFA delete.
 3. Add a lifecycle rule to transition objects older than 180 days to Glacier.
 4. Document the new policy in the legal‑review packet.

- **Step 3 – Finance backup share hardening** (owner: Zane Smith)
 1. Audit NTFS permissions on **//fileserver/finance/backups**.
 2. Restrict write access to Finance Lead and remove broad domain groups.
 3. Enable auditing of file access events and forward logs to the security SIEM.
 4. Verify the remediation date **2026‑02‑15** (restricted folder) is met and update the inventory.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All three stores are marked **compliant** in the inventory draft located at **/shared/security/audit/inventory_draft**.
- Validation logs for **/srv/db/legacy_pg** show no pipeline failures and are stored under **/shared/security/audit/validation_results**.
- Updated S3 bucket policy for **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025** is attached to the legal‑review packet and passes the compliance scanner.
- Access control list for **//fileserver/finance/backups** reflects only authorized Finance personnel and audit logs show no unauthorized access attempts.
- Each remediation is completed on or before its respective target date (**2026‑02‑12**, **2026‑02‑15**, **2026‑02‑20**) and documented in the legal‑review packet.

form.title: Remediate non‑compliant data stores – Security Audit

artifacts.summary: Formal sign‑off approving the audit deliverable

items.text:
## Background

The Security Audit of Existing Data Stores progressed through inventory collection (Irene Cruz and Zane Smith placed the latest on‑prem PostgreSQL cluster list and flagged S3 buckets in **/shared/security/audit/inventory_draft**, marked as a restricted folder). Cross‑reference against the compliance matrix identified three non‑compliant locations: **/srv/db/legacy_pg** with remediation target **2026‑02‑12**, **s3://company‑data‑archive‑2025** (keep within the team) with remediation target **2026‑02‑20** (keep within the team), and **//fileserver/finance/backups** (restricted folder) with remediation target **2026‑02‑15** (restricted folder). The findings were presented on 2026‑02‑02 in the "Security Audit Review – Findings Presentation" meeting attended by Irene Cruz (Senior Platform Engineer), Leon Marchetti (ML Engineer), and Zane Smith (Security Engineer). The meeting concluded with a deferred scope‑lock pending legal sign‑off. Zane Smith subsequently issued the formal decision **Approve audit findings and remediation plan**, authorizing the remediation schedule pending the required legal review.

## Recommendation

Proceed with the remediation plan as outlined: lock the audit scope, initiate the PostgreSQL cleanup, S3 bucket policy update, and finance backup share hardening according to the target dates. Ensure the legal‑review packet in **/shared/security/audit/legal_review** is signed off by Aarav Tanaka (General Counsel) before any remediation work begins. Once legal sign‑off is recorded, the owners—Irene Cruz for PostgreSQL cleanup, Zane Smith for S3 and backup share actions, and Leon Marchetti for pipeline‑impact validation—should execute their tasks within the sprint, updating the inventory draft to reflect compliance.

## Conditions

- Legal sign‑off from Aarav Tanaka (General Counsel) must be documented in **/shared/security/audit/legal_review** before any remediation activity starts.
- Leon Marchetti must complete the pipeline‑impact validation for **/srv/db/legacy_pg** and store the results in **/shared/security/audit/validation_results**; remediation cannot be marked complete until validation shows no breakage.
- Each remediation action must be finished on or before its respective target date (**2026‑02‑12**, **2026‑02‑15**, **2026‑02‑20**) and the inventory draft must be updated to reflect the compliant status.
- All documentation, including the inventory draft, legal‑review packet, and validation results, must remain in their designated restricted folders and not be disseminated beyond the security, platform, and legal engineering circles.
